title: トランプ氏暗殺未遂の背景に米民主党側の「過激な言辞」…銃撃2日前に「未亡人」寸劇騒動
extracted_text: 米国のトランプ大統領とホワイトハウス記者会との夕食会での発砲は、大統領の暗殺未遂事件とみなされるようになった。ホワイトハウスも司法当局も公式に暗殺という用語を使い、容疑者自身も暗殺者と自称しているのだ。 ワシントン・ヒルトンホテルでの大統領暗殺未遂と聞くと、記者（古森）はどうしても1981年3月末のロナルド・レーガン大統領（当時）暗殺未遂を想起する。レーガン氏はまさにこのホテルを出たところで25歳の青年に狙撃され、重傷を負いながらも一命をとりとめた。記者は現場近くに居合わせ、レーガン氏が至近の大学病院に運ばれた直後の光景を目撃した。 2つの事件で共通したのは、警備要員が大統領の体にかぶさり背後から保護する構えだった。安倍晋三元首相が暗殺された事件との警備の差をどうしても連想させられた。 さて今回の事件への多様な反響の中でもまず耳目を引くのは、与党・共和党側からの「（野党）民主党によるトランプ氏非難のあまりに過激な言辞が犯人をあおった」という指摘だった。共和党全国委員長のジョー・グルターズ氏は「今回の攻撃は過激左派の言葉による政治暴力の不可避な結果だ」と述べた。 その批判はコール・アレン容疑者が「声明文」でトランプ氏らを指して「小児性愛者、強姦（ごうかん）魔、反逆者はもう許せない」と糾弾した言語をあげ、民主党側の一部が同様の表現をトランプたたきで使ってきたことを指摘した。
translated_text: The shooting at the dinner between US President Trump and the White House Press Corps has come to be regarded as an assassination attempt on the president. Both the White House and judicial authorities have officially used the term assassination, and the suspect himself has self-identified as an assassin. When hearing about the assassination attempt on the president at the Washington Hilton Hotel, the reporter (Furumori) cannot help but recall the assassination attempt on President Ronald Reagan (at the time) at the end of March 1981. Reagan was indeed shot by a 25-year-old young man right as he was leaving this hotel, and narrowly survived despite being seriously wounded. The reporter was present near the scene and witnessed the scene right after Reagan was taken to the nearby university hospital. What was common in the two incidents was the security personnel's posture of covering the president's body and protecting him from behind. This inevitably brings to mind the difference in security compared to the incident where former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe was assassinated. Now, among the diverse reactions to this incident, the first thing that catches attention is the observation from the ruling Republican side that 'the Democratic Party's excessively radical rhetoric against Trump goaded the perpetrator.' Republican National Committee Chairman Joe Groeter stated, 'This attack is an unavoidable result of political violence by radical left-wing rhetoric.' That criticism cites the language Cole Allen used in his 'statement' to denounce Trump and others as 'pedophiles, rapists, and traitors who can no longer be forgiven,' pointing out that some on the Democratic side had used similar expressions in their attacks on Trump.
title_en: Radical rhetoric from US Democrats behind Trump assassination attempt...Farce over 'widow' skit 2 days before shooting
